doc: Latitude window of the marine stratocumulus, smoothstep(0.3, 0.5, x) (1 - smoothstep(0.95, 1.25, x)), over x from -0.2 to 3 (a negative x is outside the window), the four knees and 1e6. Float64 closed form: 1e-9 (measured: bit-identical to a math-module scalar evaluation on this machine (6e-17 at most for exp)). params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
